tab1.title: Country Profile
tab1.content:
• India is a country in South Asia.
  • It is known for its diverse cultures, languages, religions, and traditions.
  • India is the world's most populous country.
  • New Delhi is the capital of India.
  • India is a federal parliamentary republic.

tab2.title: Geography & Culture
tab2.content:
• India has mountains, plains, deserts, forests, rivers, and long coastlines.
  • The Himalayas form a major mountain system in northern India.
  • The Ganges is one of India's most important rivers.
  • India has hundreds of languages and many regional cultures.
  • Indian cuisine includes a wide variety of regional dishes and cooking traditions.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• India is home to the Taj Mahal.
  • India has one of the world's largest railway networks.
  • Yoga originated in ancient India.
  • India has 28 states and 8 union territories.
  • India's national animal is the Bengal tiger.
